name: splitpage
description: Build, lint and test tooling for Splitpage. The app itself has no runtime dependencies; esbuild builds the bundle, eslint checks every source tree in it (see eslint.config.mjs), TypeScript type-checks the new source folders and parses source for the dependency and comment gates, and jsdom lends the unit tests a DOM (see build.mjs and src/test/_dom.mjs).

scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run check:deps && npm run check:comments && node build.mjs && git diff --exit-code -- sw.js && npm run test:all
